subject: Recommended Sample Size for Multiple Group 2PL/GPCM

messages.author: 938d2cd6a714081f
messages.subject: Recommended Sample Size for Multiple Group 2PL/GPCM
parts:
Dear All,

does somebody know a reference indicating the recommended sample size for multiple group 2PL/GPC models?

Thanks in advance for any hints!

Best wishes
Christoph

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Recommended Sample Size for Multiple Group 2PL/GPCM
parts:
Hi Christoph,

I don't think that such recommendations exist since there are a lot of moving pieces to work with. The test length, type of item, number of response categories, magnitude of the IRT parameters, underlying theta distribution, and so on, all play a part in the power computations; so, overall it's quite difficult to tell. The more individuals collected the better, and for the 2PL you could get away with fewer. The only way to really tell is via simulations that focus on the output statistics you're interested in (e.g., power/Type I errors, stability of parameter estimates, etc). HTH.

Phil
